financials.key_metric: Presence in 180+ countries, 1500 FI clients in clearing

overall_strategy_summary: Citi is undergoing a major transformation under CEO Jane Fraser, simplifying the organisation and investing heavily in technology. Key digital initiatives: Citi Token Services for cash (live in US, UK, SG, HK, Dublin), CIDAP enterprise platform, crypto custody launching 2026, stablecoin exploration (BVNK investment). Broader strategy: simplification programme, consent order remediation ($135.6M penalties in 2024 for data governance), Google Cloud AI partnership, wealth management growth, cross-border payments leadership, and 24/7 financial operations vision. Technology spend focused on modernisation, AI, and regulatory compliance.
